guidebook.intro: Talk about the farm, the banana garden and the harvest. You’ll also learn to do things for someone else.

tips.title: Doing it for someone: -ir- / -er-
body: Add **-ir-** or **-er-** before the last vowel to do something for someone: **Ninhinga** (I dig) → **Ninhingira** (I dig for); **Ninteeka** (I cook) → **Ninteekyera** (I cook for).

culture.title: The banana garden
body: Every homestead has its **orutookye**, a banana garden, next to the house. Millet, beans, groundnuts and coffee (**omwani**) grow in the fields, and harvest time, **amasharuro**, brings the family together.
